log_level.description: Verbosity of logging; options: debug, info, warn, error

log_file.description: Path to the CANID log file

worker_count.description: Number of worker processes to spawn

max_cache_entries.description: Maximum number of entries in the cache (0 = unlimited)

default_ttl.description: Default time-to-live (TTL) for cached entries, in seconds

name.description: Name of the network interface (e.g., eth0, wlan0)

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor for DNS queries

address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) of the upstream DNS server

port.description: Port number of the upstream DNS server

upstream_servers.description: Upstream DNS servers for recursive resolution

path.description: Path to the local cache file (used if type = file)

db.description: Redis database number (used if type = redis)

storage.description: Configuration for the cache storage backend

items.description: CIDR notation for allowed query source (e.g., 127.0.0.0/8, ::1/128)

allow_sources.description: List of allowed source networks/CIDRs for DNS queries. Empty = localhost only

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support (queries, responses, and upstream resolution)
